responsibility: This source file implements the substantial library of default target hook functions that backends inherit through target-def.h unless they override them. It provides generic behavior for address legitimacy, calling convention details, builtin expansion support, mode promotion, EH and libgcc defaults, vectorization and cost-model hooks, OpenACC helpers, speculation-safety and memtag operations, stack protection, section/output decisions, libc capability predicates, and many other backend services, often by translating older target macros into hook-based form during GCC’s target-hook migration.
same_name_distinction: Implements the substantive default target hook behaviors that backends inherit, often bridging legacy target macros to hook form, whereas gcc/targhooks.h only declares those default hook functions for use in target initializers and overrides.
